text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"A dedicated dance, huh...?
Man, it's so sparkly."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes,
it is a wonderful, deeply atmospheric dance...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Next time, El wants to dance the "Honoh Dance"
together too! Uh, Mambo!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's quite an avant-garde dance~!
I wonder if that works too...?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...No way. When you dance, El, you make
sure to use the proper choreography, right?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
C-Claro...
El will make sure to remember that, yes, sir...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right!
Let's do our best to memorize it too, Nature!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
??
You don't want to enter, Nature-desu ka?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Man, performing a dedicatory dance is way too lofty for someone like me~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Standing on such a sparkling stage...
Such an audacious dream is far, far beyond me...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The Shundai Festival is a celebration for all Umamusume...
Everyone has the right to stand on the main stage and shine.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly!
So let's do our best so you can run in it!
Ei, ei, mun!
